body.p: The hunterman. You know? The hunterman has two daughters. He has a wife. The hunterman deals only with hunting. When the weather becomes autumn. The hunterman obtains only wild bulls. Yeah. Wild reindeer heads â¦ from the North wind. From the warm side.[ShA:] A false start in the middle. He used them as wind enclosures. So. The hunterman then. His job will be always hunting. His wife, of course, is always at home. And his two children are still small. Both of them are girls. Yes, the sisters. So. At some time the hunterman. The wife is at home, of course. The weather was autumnal. Still there was no snow. At some time they were fund by a person. The wife of the hunterman. She is seeing there. A huge person is going along the hill ridge, a person is going. She looks at him silently, standing near the door. Him, she thinks, like a man does not â¦ He is not like a human. She has no clothes. Her hair was long. She sees, all her body has hair. Oh, she thinks, this one. So, the wife of the hunterman thinks. Oh, her only clothes are the hair on her body. Of course, that's hair, as she observes from the door. Her children are at home. Now she reached the woman. Well, as for her. Anyway. Probably, she knew any true language, a human language. Somehow they spoke, after all. And the one who came then. And the Enets woman so. â¦ she thinks. People say. Somewhere there is a witch. She lives in the forest. She thinks, what if the witch found me? Yeah, she thinks, probably this is the witch people speak of. So, and me, she thinks. After I grew up, after my two eyes started looking. I have never seen a witch. By her appearance she does look like a human. But she has no clothes. Well, how, somehow they understood one another's words. And. It seems, the witch said so to the Enets woman. The Enets woman, she said. Now the weather became autumnal. She said, let's go to collect hay. Let's pick hay for ourselves. Let's collect, he said. Well, now the Enets woman said. Well, as for the hay, we will, of course pick it. The Enets woman only thinks. We will go to pick hale. She will bring me somewhere, after all. Maybe she will take me away even forever. Yes, she said, there, to any lands, she said. She can even eat me. People say, a witch kills a human and can eat him. Well, then the Enets woman. Unwillingly put on her clothes. Well, and the other one is waiting for his mate. She is even standing, whirling on his legs. Let's go to collect hay! And as for the girls. The girls were here at home. One of them is already a big girl. And the other one is younger than her sister. The Enets woman unwillingly put on her clothes. Well, she said, let's go. They went for something. To do, well, what kind of work. But generally that one. The witch then. We say 'olasne', but also people say 'porne'. The witch started speaking, he said. We will now collect hay, he said. We will tear hay for ourselves. The weather will become wintery soon. So they left. The woman's daughter was already big. Anyway then, she thinks, well. Our mother, she thinks, this person. A human, she thinks, a human. Yes. This person, she thinks, will kill our mother, after all. She will kill her. She can eat her. So. Oh, some time later. And somewhere in the forest, well. They sat down at the sun. Yes. The Enets woman. The witch said to the Enets woman. The Enets woman, the Enets woman, he said, let me look for your louses. (â¦). The Enets woman said. First, she said, let me look for your louses. Yes. (â¦). The Enets woman, well, the Enets woman, she said, what about my louses. Look for them, look for them, he said, sit down. Of his mate â¦ The Enets woman, having stretched so her legs. Sat down, of course, what. She will search the head of her mate, after all â¦ If she has louses. Well, her hair is long, the hair of her head. The hair of her head it is long, of course. The Enets woman, the Enets woman, she said. The Enets woman said, Oh, you have a lot of louses! So the Enets woman sees. The louses of the witch. Are beetles, different insects crawling along the ground. They right move near the roots of her hair. So, the Enets woman catches them and throws them on the ground. Oh, the witch â¦ The Enets woman, the Enets woman, she said, why do you throw my louses at the ground? My louses, she said, take them away into your mouth. Well, the Enets woman thinks. Well. So lot, well, insects. Will I take away into my mouth everyone? Well, she simply released them down. So she does as if she takes (them) into [ShA:] The syntax is not completely her mouth. The giant makes no sound, I don't know. Maybe she is sleeping while her clear.mate is sleeping. Yes, some time later. The Enets woman said, well. Rather, the witch said. The Enets woman, the Enets woman, now you lie down here on my knees. Me, she said, let me look for your louses, she said. Also. As for me, she said, you caught my louses, she said. This is already fine. Well, the Enets woman, though unwillingly, lay down. So, at the legs of her mate, of the witch. (â¦). And this witch is so. She had such a thing, after all.[ShA:] A false start. She turned out to have sharp iron. Now we say here, an awl. She had an iron thing like an awl. An awl, in sum. Well, to say it right, she had an awl. So the Enets woman looks at her. What to do? Yes, she took out from somewhere her awl. Maybe she has something there in her hair. I don't know, maybe it was wrapped in her hair. Yeah. So, she started looking at the hair of the Enets woman. She stuck it into the Enets woman's ear. (â¦). And a person whose ear was stuck in, then. Will die, of course. She died, of course, this reached her brain, her head, of course. So, well. It seems, the witch said so. The Enets woman, the Enets woman, I had to do with you so. Now I will bring you to my home. I will bring you home. I even will not bring you home. Me, she said. I will boil you at your home. I will eat you. It has really picked hail, after all. The hay, there is a lot of hay on the ground, after all. She wrapped the Enets woman into this hay. Into this hay. In order that she were not be seen. The Enets woman's hair was long, after all. Her hair was tied up, she wore a plait. Formerly people wore plaits. She cannot, well, the Enets woman's hair down. Well, let her hair dangle. Well, so she carries her, having thrown her her arms around. And, well, she brought her to the Enets woman's home. Where she took her away from. Well, and the girls. The elder one, the younger one, probably, was too little. And the elder one understands everything. Say, my mother with her â¦ went there. They will come back from there, after all. And yea, the witch is going alone. This girl sees. And, well. And only the mind of this girl works, she thinks. But we have no mother. â¦ she is already an intelligent girl, probably, she was already a big girl. So, she thinks, the witch killed our mother, of course. And, probably, she has eaten our mother. She reached the tent. (â¦). This. As for the Enets woman, she is not seen, she is wrapped into the hay. She is not seen, he put her near the door. So. This girl sees. She thinks, this is, well of my mother. Her hair is seen, she thinks. Her plait is seen, she thinks. It seems, she smothered her, she thinks. It seems, she killed my mother. So, only this girl's mind works. And us, she thinks, we also had a father. Since our father left. Since he left, she thinks, he is absent more than a day. Him, she thinks. Couldn't the witch do the same with our father? Yes, our father does not come. And it seems, he also did so with my mother. And then. (â¦). The giant then. Well, she said, well.[ShA:] A false start. To these girls. You, she said, don't leave from here anywhere. Stay here! And me, she said, I'll go home. I will take there my hay, oh! Probably, she has a home somewhere. The witch threw her again into her handful, the human. She took her away, she carried her away on her shoulder, she left towards the forest. The girl stayed. The girl stayed. Well, the witch there. Brought her home. Well, probably she had something. Anyway she cut the Enets woman, probably. She did some way, probably. She also had two daughters, two children. She had children. And this giant boiled a pot. It boiled up. So the giant, the witch eats, of course. (â¦). And the daughter of the Enets woman. After the witch left. She had a mother, she had a father. Her father is still absent. One of them was already big. Her intelligence is already fine, she thinks, now. What will we wait for in an empty tent? It would be fine, she thinks, if we look for somewhere. She, she thinks. She will terminate us right here. She ate our mother and took away our father. Our father does never come. The witch did the same with him, after all. And. There will be no people on the Earth, after all. She thinks. While the things are fine, we would better go anywhere. So the elder one thinks. Oh, she started raking in her mother's corner. (â¦). Of course, she wants to leave somewhere, to escape.[ShA:] A false start. The daughter of the Enets woman. First. She rakes and rakes in her mother's corner. She found such her mother's knife for cutting, a knife for cutting. This knife for cutting is, certainly, curved. That's for making something out. And this daughter of the Enets woman had a bundle. Maybe she would wrap it, she put it there. It would be fine, of course, if I take away my mother's knife. So. She still rakes, still rakes. Oh, once she found her mother's scythe. And do you know what scythe is? So, she found her mother's scythe. And so the girl looks at this, well. This, she thinks, land. My mother kept it, after all. Once, she thought, this still can be useful for me. She also took this. She also took this. Oh, at some time she found her mother's knife. So she found, of course, her mother's scythe. Some time later, well. She found her mother's comb, after all. Oh, and this, she thinks, is her mother's comb. She knows, her mother uses it to brush her hair. This, she thinks, if such a day will come. This also will be necessary, probably. Her mother's comb also there. Also from her mother's things. She also took a lot. Yes, she collected. Well, probably it would be fine to go. (â¦).[ShA:] A They will escape â¦ The next day, having eaten, the giant would come.false start. And the daughter of the Enets woman knows. Now the giant is sleeping having eaten. Yes, well. The daughter of the Enets woman thinks. While she is sleeping, we will break away to some distance. And this sister of hers was little. She could not walk. Oh, I, well. Sh still rakes in her mother's corner. Now we say, an awl, sharp iron. An awl. Well, a woman of course, would not use an awl. Probably, it was her father's awl. She also such an awl, oh, she said, this. It would be fine, she thinks, if I take the awl. The awl. Yes, she also put it there. I will take the awl, she thinks. So, she is already a big girl, she thinks. Now, she thinks. We will not ride by reindeer, after all. I will walk by my two foot, after all. Well, she wore any shoes, probably. She thinks. If I tear the cover of my legs, my shoes. I will sew them up with this awl, after all. If one goes by foot, she thinks, they will tear. Yes, she also out this there. So, she has a sack somewhere â¦ So she put it there to the sack. So, their foodstuff. Of course, they had something. What, their father is a hunterman, after all. He gets any prey, he is a hunter. So she thinks. But this little sister of mine cannot go by foot, after all. Yes. So they had a sledge made by their father. Their little sledge, say, there happen to be here little sledges, a little sledge. She, probably, took these things and foodstuff, and fastened all this onto the sledge. And she also sat her sister down onto the sledge. Well, so she went where her eyes look. She does not know herself where she went. Well, there are no people near them, there is no one. The land is empty. (â¦). So the daughter of the Enets woman goes around, goes around. So she counts in her mind. She is already a big girl, after all. They go longer than a day. So, being frightened, she walks without sleeping. She does not know people. She even does not know where there are people. The land is empty. She cannot find people anyway. She still goes. Oh, at some time. The giant, the witch this Enets person. Where the girl went. Where she went. I don't know if her footprint was seen or anyway. Her mate, say. One can hear, the giant is going, she is going with such a noise. Yeah. The Enets woman, one can hear, she says. The Enets girl! I will catch you, I will get you! I even will not kill you. I will eat you alive. Oh, the girl got afraid. Well, now, of course, she thinks. She will terminate us, of course. So the giant appeared. She appeared. So, well. As we have said recently, she found her mother's scythe. Of course, she threw her mother's scythe in front of her. This scythe became a huge iron hill. And only the noise of the giant's fingernails can be heard. As for the scythe, what. It's iron, after all. So she stayed scratching where she was. The daughter of the Enets, well, of the Enets woman, the Enets girl. Again broke away to some distance. Oh, some time later the giant's cry appeared again. Again her cry appeared. Well. Completely â¦ she came very close â¦ She says still all the same. I will catch you, I will eat you alive! And this girl drags her sister and does only run. Well. Some time later. What was said of. A walking person would not find place there. Only her noise can be heard between these trees. And again only one thing is heard. I will get you, I will catch you, I will eat you! This girl again break off and left again. Well, she has nothing more. She has nothing more. And then, then the girl. There was such a river in front of her. There was a river there. At the opposite bank of the river, as she sees, a little tent can be seen. She never found people. She thinks, â¦ That's a tent like our tent, after all. Well, how would you get there, the river was deep. What if the horrible one also would come to that tent? Well. Oh, there's a river there. At the opposite bank, an old man is going about near his tent. Yeah. One old man. There near his tent. He strolls. Probably, he does something.
